concept.title: Example: Using dvrKeyscopeSuffix to control key scope names
concept.shortdesc: In this scenario, a ditavalref element uses the nested dvrKeyscopeSuffix element to control the names of key scopes within the filtered branch.

conbody.p: The following code sample shows how dvrKeyscopeSuffix supplements the existing key scope name of branch-01 to establish two new effective key scopes:<topicref keys="branch-01" href="branch-01.dita" keyscope="branch-01" > <ditavalref href="condition-01.ditaval"> <ditavalmeta> <dvrResourcePrefix>firstcond-</dvrResourcePrefix> <dvrKeyscopeSuffix>-green</dvrKeyscopeSuffix> </ditavalmeta> </ditavalref> <ditavalref href="condition-01.ditaval"> <ditavalmeta> <dvrResourcePrefix>secondcond-</dvrResourcePrefix> <dvrKeyscopeSuffix>-blue</dvrKeyscopeSuffix> </ditavalmeta> </ditavalref> <keydef keys="productName"> <topicmeta><keytext>Acme's Best Microchip</keytext></topicmeta> </keydef> <topicref href="topics/subtopic-01.dita"/> </topicref>

After the ditavalref elements are evaluated:
With two ditavalref elements, two effective copies of the branch are created.
For the first effective copy of the branch:
The effective key scope is branch-01-green
The effective file names of the resources in the branch are firstcond-branch-01.dita and topics/firstcond-subtopic-01.dita
For the second effective copy of the branch:
The effective key scope is branch-01-blue
The effective file names of the resources in the branch are secondcond-branch-01.dita and topics/secondcond-subtopic-01.dita
